visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor office with white walls and professional desks. A woman in a green striped shirt and wide-leg jeans stands, gesturing with her hand toward another woman in an olive jacket sitting at a desk. A man sits in the background. Lighting is bright and even. (2) The scene shifts as the office workers stand up to leave. A man in a black hoodie enters through a doorway in the background, smiling broadly and waving. Yellow text overlays appear at the top. (3) Grayscale filter applied. The man in the black hoodie stands alone in the empty office, holding his smartphone and looking down with a dejected, pained facial expression. (4) Office kitchen area with a wooden table and large windows. Two women are looking at a phone and laughing intensely. The man in the black hoodie approaches from the background, holding a coffee mug. (5) Grayscale filter returns. The man stands alone at the table, mug in hand, staring into the distance with a look of confusion and sadness. (6) Inside a metallic elevator with bright ceiling lights. The two women are leaning against the walls, laughing hysterically with their hands over their mouths. The man in the black hoodie stands next to them, looking straight ahead with a stiff posture and awkward expression. (7) The elevator ride continues. The women continue to giggle while looking at their phones. The man looks at the camera, placing a hand on his chest with a forced, uncomfortable smile, then looks down awkwardly.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Energetic female conversation with a fast speech rate and bright vocal tone. Background music is a mid-tempo, upbeat acoustic guitar track. (2) A male voice enters with a high-pitched, enthusiastic 'Hey!', which quickly shifts to a whiny, lower-arousal tone as the music changes to a slow, sentimental piano melody. (3) Sharp hard cut back to loud, high-arousal female laughter. The music stops abruptly, leaving only the sound of intense giggling and breathing. (4) The sad piano melody returns as the male voice asks a question with an uncertain, submissive tone. (5) Another hard cut to extremely loud, overlapping female laughter. The pitch is high and the arousal is at its peak. (6) Sudden transition to near-silence inside the elevator. There is a low-frequency environmental hum. The women are making soft, snorting sounds and suppressed giggles. The male speaker remains silent, creating a high-tension acoustic environment.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously portray the social awkwardness and sense of 'exclusion' felt by a boss when trying to join in on the fun or conversations of his younger employees.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses exaggerated facial expressions and common meme audio tropes (sad piano music vs. sudden silence) to highlight corporate social dynamics.
